guruji.hero.name: Mahanth Swami Shri Avdheshkumar Das Ji Maharaj
guruji.hero.subtitle: Spiritual guide and leader of Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram
guruji.about.heading: About
guruji.about.p1: Mahanth Swami Shri Avdheshkumar Das Ji Maharaj is a revered spiritual leader of the Ramanandi tradition, guiding countless devotees on the path of Shri Ram Bhakti, devotion, and selfless service. His life embodies the principles of Sanatan Dharma and the sacred Bhaktamal parampara.
guruji.about.p2: Under his divine guidance, Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram continues to serve as a beacon of spiritual light in Ayodhya, spreading the message of Lord Ram's devotion and organizing numerous religious and humanitarian activities throughout the year.

guruji.leadership.katha.title: Shri Ram Katha
guruji.leadership.katha.desc: Regular discourses on the life and teachings of Lord Ram, inspiring devotees nationwide
guruji.leadership.guidance.title: Spiritual Guidance

guruji.leadership.religious.title: Religious Leadership

guruji.leadership.welfare.title: Social Welfare
guruji.leadership.welfare.desc: Organizing Annadan, Gaushala Seva, and humanitarian services
guruji.leadership.teaching.title: Scriptural Teaching
guruji.leadership.teaching.desc: Imparting knowledge of Vedic scriptures and spiritual philosophy
guruji.teachings.title: Teachings & Philosophy
guruji.teachings.intro: Maharaj ji's teachings emphasize the importance of devotion (Bhakti), righteous living (Dharma), and selfless service (Seva) as the pillars of spiritual growth. His discourses blend traditional wisdom with practical guidance for modern devotees, making ancient teachings accessible and relevant.
guruji.teachings.bhakti.title: Bhakti Yoga
guruji.teachings.bhakti.desc: The path of pure devotion and love for Lord Ram as the supreme means of spiritual realization
guruji.teachings.dharma.title: Dharma in Daily Life
guruji.teachings.dharma.desc: Living according to righteous principles in all aspects of personal and social life
guruji.teachings.seva.title: Seva as Worship
guruji.teachings.seva.desc: Serving humanity as the highest form of worship and devotion to the divine

guruji.guidance.annadan.title: Annadan Seva

guruji.guidance.development.title: Ashram Development
guruji.guidance.development.desc: Expansion and enhancement of ashram facilities to serve increasing numbers of devotees and pilgrims
guruji.guidance.outreach.title: Outreach Programs
guruji.guidance.outreach.desc: Spreading the message of Shri Ram Bhakti through visits to various cities and participation in major religious gatherings
guruji.cta.title: Seek Blessings & Guidance
guruji.cta.desc: Visit Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram to receive the blessings and spiritual guidance of Maharaj ji
